verification: V7 is grounded at the final six-channel ignition actuator. Canonical ms41emu executes both real CALLS hooks, every switch/RPM/Launch request case, and both complete return paths including the manual-backed 0x65 stock `ANDB P1L,RL1`. Its native-entry matrix covers all six ADB2 single-cylinder masks, all six fd5e.8/ADC4 paired-cylinder masks, and the second recurring ADB2 site on both MS41.2 and MS41.3, while checking Port 1 effects plus stack/DPP/register hygiene. Physical spark interruption remains an on-car validation item.
title: Ignition Cut
user_description: Adds a configurable ignition-cut rev limiter at the ECU's proven six-cylinder coil final-stage charge commands. Emulator and static hardware-path verification are complete; vehicle testing is still required.
description: Replaces both recurring `andb P1L,RL1` coil-charge transactions at file 0x3992A and 0x3998E with CALLS to a shared program-high cave at file 0x39C70. Standalone cut arms with CUTSW (FF=off, 00=always, 01/02/04=pin80/81/82) and triggers when actual rpm/32 at 0xFC3C reaches CUTRPM. Launch Control may independently request spark cut through fd5a.7. Stock ADB2 masks clear one P1L.0..5 cylinder output plus companion P1L.6/.7; the fd5e.8 ADC4 masks clear paired cylinder outputs plus a companion bit. The cut path suppresses that complete scheduled mask transaction, while the stock path replays the exact displaced ANDB. Injector CC0-CC5 scheduling, CC6/CC7 timer scheduling, O2-heater control, VPP P2.6, and the later coil-release/watchdog paths remain untouched. Supersedes field-failed V6 and all older ignition-cut revisions.
